title: Horse Noises
blurb: Enormous and emotionally volatile, and it sounds exactly like that. A horse in full vocal expression, neighing and snorting and communicating a level of feeling entirely disproportionate to whatever prompted it, remains one of the most dramatic noises any animal produces. Cinema has leaned on it for a century, usually to signal that a scene has turned. Play it for cowboy edits, for unexpected arrivals, or for any situation where the only appropriate response left available to you is simply a horse.
